name: persistence-comparison
description: What the harness treats as the persistence contract when comparing OLD and NEW.
the_contract_is: Query result sets, compared as ordered or unordered sets according to the query
Database and document state after the scenario
Transaction outcome: committed, rolled back, or failed
Lock behaviour observable to the caller
Schema behaviour: what DDL the provider chose to emit
the_contract_is_not: The literal text of generated SQL
Statement ordering within a transaction where the outcome is unchanged

generated_sql.rationale: Two statements can differ in text and be identical in effect, and identical in text while behaving differently under a new dialect. Comparing the text produces both false alarms and false confidence, so it is evidence for a human rather than a gate.

state_capture.relational: Row counts and full row content per touched table, ordered by primary key
state_capture.document: Document count and canonical JSON per touched collection, ordered by _id
state_capture.sensitive_columns: Represented by SensitiveValues metadata, never captured in plaintext

environment_requirement: A persistence dimension is only compared when the equivalence contract marks the database vendor and version MUST_MATCH and they do match. Otherwise the dimension is NOT_COMPARED with a reason.
